more.title: Shell loses Concourt battle over exploration of oil, gas in Eastern Cape
more.description: Shell has lost a legal battle over plans to explore for oil and gas off South Africa’s ecologically sensitive Wild Coast. This comes after the courts found that the exploration rights and permissions for seismic surveys had been granted unlawfully. The ruling centres on the approval of exploration activities involving oil and gas companies Shell and Impact Africa, with the courts finding shortcomings in the public consultation process. This is a developing story
